title: 4 · The clinician reads the IPS and gives care
description: Dr Mele reads the verified summary: asthma, the inhaler Sefa uses, and an allergy to sulfonamides. Dr Mele treats the attack with a medicine Sefa is not allergic to. Optionally, the clinic gives Sefa an encounter summary to take home.
where: A walk-in clinic in Lumara, Taifafeki
